dict.string: Fishing spots along the town's coast with a timing minigame: a cast costs bait, and the catch is a fish you can wield (badly) or sell at the Gambler. A pirate fisherman on the old boat by the trading post sells bait and rod upgrades; your rod shows in the character screen's gear grid. Now and then a fishing hole appears at the start of a run that pays food, mana and gear. Part of HammerwatchPlus.
